notes.title: Playtest Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
Cozy Crunch Playtest Update 0.1.4:

Polish/Clarification:
- Added translations for steam achievements
- Switched Portuguese to be Brazilian Portuguese
- Added translations for features in added in previous/current patch
- Changed up timing for crunch animation so triple crunch can line up with the music and add an extra challenge!
- Moved dialogue to separate audio channel and added a separate volume slider for dialogue in settings
- Did a quick rebalance of audio, will need a more in depth one later
- Leaf bits now follow a randomized curved path when collected
- Player now jumps into/out of character creator

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
- When buying all final upgrade at same time as another upgrade that triggers dialogue, unable to interact with leaf roaster/magic cat/char creator afterwards (until relaunching game)
- Some areas at edges of map don’t show tiles
- Some buttons not making hover/click sounds
- Bridge achievement not working

Polish/Clarification:
- Added pause/rotate buttons to character creator spinning
- Handle steam achievements when offline
- Encrypted achievements/save files
- Settings no longer create a new file every update

NOTE: This update adds some breaking changes making old save files/settings no longer work.

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
- Steam Achievements not triggering
- Negative currency occurring when collecting leaf bits occasionally
- When discovering stealth and dialogue pops up, currencies don’t shift down properly until new leaf bits obtained
- Some windows not closing with “ESC” key

Polish/Clarification:
- Organize upgrades by cost.
- Added popup confirmation when clicking in-game discord button
- Made large bush icon look like large bush

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
- Dialogue popup during upgrade showing up at wrong time.  Had to press “ESC” key to proceed.
- Discord logo showing up as leaf-bit shadow.
- Hat not auto-equipping on prestige

Polish:
- Arrow in starting area to help guide new players

Fixed various typos.
